ordinary_guardianship_scope: For ordinary uncontested guardianship, annual reporting is the only additional firm fee. Routine administration, closing and termination within the retained scope are included. The Annual Report on the Ward costs $750 per year for preparation and filing. A later contested proceeding requires its own specifically accepted fixed-fee addendum.
annual_scope_note: Only the verified $750 personal annual-report fee is shown. Conflicting accounting and bundle figures are excluded pending reconciliation.
